fenton_mckee_1990.formula: k*d = x**2 * (coth(x**nu))**(1/nu), x = omega*sqrt(d/g), nu = 3/2 (Eq. 21: L = L0*tanh((2*pi*sqrt(d/g)/T)**1.5)**(2/3))
fenton_mckee_1990.max_error_statement: accuracy always better than 1.7% (abstract); maximum error of only 1.7% (p. 507)
fenton_mckee_1990.limits: exact for long (shallow) and short (deep) waves
fenton_mckee_1990.source: https://johndfenton.com/Papers/Fenton90c+McKee-On-calculating-the-lengths-of-water-waves.pdf (PDF fetched 2026-09-24, text extracted with pymupdf) — Coastal Engineering 14, 499-513 (1990), doi:10.1016/0378-3839(90)90032-R

cnoidal.solitary: H*sech((x - c*t)/Delta)**2, c = sqrt(g*h)*(1 + H/(2*h)), Delta = h*sqrt(4*h/(3*H))
